annotation.title_clean: National Artificial Intelligence Strategy of the Czech Republic
annotation.title_en: National Artificial Intelligence Strategy of the Czech Republic
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Ministry of Industry and Trade of the Czech Republic (Government of the Czech Republic)
annotation.venue: Ministry of Industry and Trade of the Czech Republic
annotation.summary_en: Czech national AI strategy (2019) with seven chapters: research, financing, industry, education, labour market, legal/ethical aspects, and international cooperation. Mainly innovation and competitiveness-oriented, with passing provisions on autonomous vehicles, liability and compulsory insurance for autonomous systems, regulatory sandboxes, and cybersecurity certification.
key_provisions_or_claims: Establishes an AI Committee chaired by the Minister of Industry and Trade to coordinate implementation
Plans a European Centre of Excellence, Test Centre and Digital Innovation Hubs in the Czech Republic
Analysis of liability for autonomous and collaborative systems, including possible compulsory insurance
Expert Platform and Forum to monitor legal and ethical AI rules; regulatory sandbox analysis
Retraining and social-system measures for automation's labour market impacts
